exams.source: Syllabus page 3 and the Oct 20 announcement

questions.question: What is the worst-case time to insert into a binary heap with n elements?
questions.answer: O(log n), because the new element bubbles up at most the height of the tree.

questions.question: In a hash table with chaining, what happens to the expected search time as the load factor grows?
questions.answer: It grows linearly with the load factor alpha: expected O(1 + alpha).

questions.question: Name the five red-black tree properties.
questions.answer: Every node is red or black; the root is black; leaves (NIL) are black; a red node has black children; every path from a node to its descendant leaves has the same number of black nodes.

questions.question: Which data structure does BFS use to decide which vertex to visit next?
What does build-heap cost, and why is it not O(n log n)?
questions.answer: O(n). Most nodes are near the bottom and sift down only a short distance; the sum of heights is O(n).
